reports.title: Shoals Technologies Group, Inc. Reports Financial Results for Third Quarter 2026

guidance.heading: Fourth Quarter 2026 Outlook
section: At this time, the Company is providing an outlook for the fourth quarter. Based on current business conditions, business trends and other factors, for the quarter ending December 31, 2026, the Company expects:
•Revenue in the range of $165 million to $185 million; and
•Adjusted EBITDA1 in the range of $36 million to $40 million.
